STAGE: orientation
GOAL: start ideation_4; confirm write channel and locate the codebase to avoid duplicating existing mechanisms.
READ: tool catalog (progress.append_progress present); workspace listing.
OBSERVED: working dir agents/ideation_4 appears empty of *.md; only write channel is append_progress.
REASONING: need to inspect the frozen RQ-VAE / Stage3 code before proposing mechanisms.
OPEN: find repo root and existing hyperbolic / behaviour code.

STAGE: idea selection
GOAL: fix three coupling positions that differ from the examples named in the brief (behaviour-weighted curved assignment / Sinkhorn, behaviour hierarchy quantizer, behaviour-directed curved residual).
READ: brief + frozen-scale numbers (24556 items, 24 steps/epoch, 3000 epochs = 72000 steps, batch ~1024).
OBSERVED: three orthogonal positions available: (1) behaviour sets the curvature PARAMETER of the metric; (2) behaviour sets the CHART ORIGIN (log/exp anchor) of the residual chain; (3) behaviour sets the DECISION RULE for ambiguous/colliding SIDs.
EVIDENCE: reasoning only, no run.
RESULT: IDEA: KAPPA_BRANCH | TITLE: training-branching sets a per-item curvature field that drives the RQ-VAE assignment metric. | BEHAVIOR: directed successor distribution of each training item, branch entropy h_i=H(S_i)/log(|S_i|+1) in [0,1]. | GEOMETRY: Poincare ball, curvature kappa_i=kappa0*(1+h_i) (kappa0=1, no free constant), pair curvature harmonic mean. | COUPLING: k*(i)=argmin_k d_poincare(z_i,c_k; kbar_ik); commitment term d^2 instead of ||.||^2, so the codebook gradient and the resulting SID both depend on behaviour. | SWITCHES: behaviour-off -> h_i=0, all kappa=1 (plain unit-curvature RQ); geometry-off -> Euclidean nearest code on the same vectors; both-on -> full. | COST: 786k Poincare distances/step (1024x256x3) vs dot products, ~3-5 min over 72k steps on 4 GPUs, <5%. | OPEN: full block printed in final answer.
OPEN: two more records + final blocks.

STAGE: idea 2 of 3
RESULT: IDEA: ANCHOR_TANGENT | TITLE: quantize each item in the tangent space at the hyperbolic Frechet mean of its training successors. | BEHAVIOR: transition-count-weighted successor sets S_i from training sequences only. | GEOMETRY: fixed kappa=-1 Poincare ball, Mobius exp/log; anchor m_i = Frechet mean of {w_j : j in S_i}, K=3 fixed-point iterations. | COUPLING: t_i = log_{m_i}(w_i); residual chain and codes live in that chart; decode w_hat = exp_{m_i}(sum e_l) -> decoder; so the SID encodes 'deviation from where behaviour says this item should sit'. | SWITCHES: behaviour-off -> m_i=0 (plain RQ); geometry-off -> arithmetic mean anchor and linear residual; both-on -> full. | COST: anchor precompute once O(|E| d K) < few s; per step 2 batch exp/log, <1 ms. | OPEN: full block printed in final answer.
REASONING: geometry is load-bearing because the residual is defined in a tangent space that only exists via log_m; behaviour is load-bearing because it chooses m. Removing either changes every code assignment, not just a loss term.

STAGE: idea 3 of 3
RESULT: IDEA: GEO_REPAIR | TITLE: behaviour-directed geodesic reassignment of colliding semantic IDs so the generator's reachable set stops depending on arbitrary tie-breaks. | BEHAVIOR: training in-degree plus successor geodesic centroid. | GEOMETRY: Poincare distance from the item's behaviour centroid to candidate codes (kappa=-1). | COUPLING: only colliding items are re-assigned, k*(i)=argmin_k d_P(m_i,c_k^l) at level 3 (then level 2 if the parent prefix has no free token); representative = max training in-degree keeps its SID. | SWITCHES: behaviour-off -> m_i=z_i (content tie-break = baseline); geometry-off -> Euclidean centroid/distance; both-on -> full. | COST: one hash+sort pass over 24556 SIDs per epoch plus ~5k re-assignments, <1% wall clock. | OPEN: full block printed in final answer.
REASONING: cheapest of the three and touches only the ambiguous tail of the assignment; the representative keeps the reachable SID so the generator's learned emission is not destabilised.
